For example, develop renewable energy technologies to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and reduce energy prices; develop new agricultural technologies to improve agricultural production efficiency and reduce food prices. These scientific and technological advances will make scarce resources more abundant, thereby alleviating the unfair distribution of resources caused by the gap between rich and poor.
